run_sgemm_lora_a_fwd: run sgemm_lora_a_fwd to perform a sliced GEMM forward pass for LoRA adapter A with token segmentation
run_sgemm_lora_b_fwd: run sgemm_lora_b_fwd to perform a sliced GEMM forward pass for LoRA adapter B with slice offsets and base output accumulation
test_sgemm_lora_a_fwd: test sgemm_lora_a_fwd with tensor inputs, weight indices, segment lengths, LoRA ranks, and scaling factors
test_sgemm_lora_b_fwd: test sgemm_lora_b_fwd with tensor inputs, weight indices, segment lengths, slice offsets, and optional base output
review_lora_ops: review the lora_ops module containing sgemm_lora_a_fwd and sgemm_lora_b_fwd for sliced GEMM forward passes
